articles.abstractCn: 从苏木精和伊红（H&E）染色图像预测空间基因表达为空间转录组学（ST）提供了一种经济高效的替代方案。然而，现有方法将H&E图像视为通用的视觉输入，忽略了其内在的生物学层次结构，即空间组织的细胞类型共同形成功能性的组织微环境，这些微环境调控着局部的基因表达程序。为了弥补这一差距，我们将H&E到ST的预测问题形式化为跨模态语义翻译任务，并提出Path2ST，这是一个基于层次结构的自回归框架，具有三个关键组件：（i）一种层次细胞-组织调节机制，它融合了显式和隐式的细胞特征与组织级的语义表示，以构建层次调节信号；（ii）一种在层次语义词汇表上的尺度自适应自回归生成过程，实现从粗到细、生物学一致的表达合成；（iii）SpectraLoss，一种全谱目标，联合强制顺序保真度、模拟转录爆发，并将语义结构与细胞类型对齐。在三个数据集上的大量实验展示了最先进的性能，验证了Path2ST能够生成高度准确且空间一致性的转录组图谱。相关代码已发布在https://github.com/RuochenLiu23/Path2ST。

articles.title: What Iterated Self-Feeding Probes of Language Models Measure, and a test that separates the construction from the model
articles.abstract: A growing class of methods probes a language model by feeding it its own output: self-consistency, iterated refinement, agentic loops. We ask what such a probe measures, in a construction chosen to make the question sharp: a ring of token cells resampled in place by the model's own windowed conditional p_r(x_i | x_{i+-r}). The substrate is Glauber dynamics on token sequences and is not new; what we change is the coupling. Advancing two rings that differ in one token under common random numbers makes undamaged copies diverge by exactly zero, so damage spreading becomes measurable where a maximal coupling gives mixing times instead. The answer is that it measures two different things at once, in readings that look alike. Some quantities are fixed by the construction: the damage light cone is kinematic, and the radius scaling of the token-space Lyapunov exponent lambda_ca(r) is model-invariant across 19 models and two scale ladders spanning 70x. Others genuinely track the model: lambda_ca crosses zero at a reproducible point in training, and the attractor share ranks models consistently however the lattice is built. Left undistinguished, the first kind is readily mistaken for the second -- we did so ourselves for four months, and report a phase transition we measured to three decimal places that belongs to the probe rather than to any language model. We give the test that separates them: hold the construction fixed and vary the model, or hold the model fixed and vary the construction, and see which readings move. We validate the instrument by reproduction first, recovering a Domany-Kinzel damage field bit-exactly against an independent prediction, and we report the estimator failures that this discipline caught -- four retracted verdicts, each on a quantity that looked like a measurement. The methodology ships as a package.
articles.comment: 16 pages, 4 figures. Code, per-run results, and the findings ledger: https://github.com/nicoveraz/token-lattice-ca (archived: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21880472)
articles.titleCn: 语言模型中迭代自我喂养探针测量什么，以及一个将构建与模型分离的测试
articles.abstractCn: 越来越多的方法通过将模型自身的输出输入到模型中来进行探测：自洽性、迭代精炼、智能体循环。我们探究这种探测测量了什么，选择一个使问题明确化的构造：一个由模型自身的窗口条件概率p_r(x_i | x_{i+-r})在原地重新采样的标记单元环。这个基础是标记序列上的高斯玻尔兹曼动力学，并非新概念；我们改变的是耦合方式。在相同的随机数下推进两个差异仅一个标记的环，使得未受损副本恰好以零距离发散，因此损伤传播变得可测量，而最大耦合则给出混合时间。答案是它同时测量了两种不同的事物，在看似相同的读数中。某些量由构造固定：损伤光锥是运动学的，标记空间李雅普诺夫指数lambda_ca(r)的半径标度在19个模型和跨越70x的两个尺度阶梯上都是模型不变的。另一些量确实追踪模型：lambda_ca在训练中某个可重复的点处穿过零点，吸引子份额无论晶格如何构建都一致地排名模型。若不加区分，第一种量很容易被误认为是第二种——我们曾为此困惑四个月，并报告了一个测量到小数点后三位的相变，这属于探测而非任何语言模型。我们给出了区分它们的测试：固定构造而改变模型，或固定模型而改变构造，看哪种读数会变化。我们通过首先复制来验证仪器，精确到比特地复现了Domany-Kinzel损伤场，并报告了这种纪律捕捉到的估计器失效——四个撤回的裁决，每个裁决都针对看似测量得到的量。方法论作为一个整体打包交付。

articles.title: MUSE: A Full-Text Cross-Domain Knowledge Base of Scientific Problems, Solutions, and Rationales
articles.abstract: Scientific papers contain fine-grained records of problem solving: authors mention technical obstacles and methods that were used to address them, often along with reasoning on why those methods were chosen. We introduce MUSE (Mining Underlying Scientific Explanations), a full-text, multi-domain resource of scientific Problem-Solution-Rationale (P-S-R) triplets. We curate 579 expert-annotated full-text paragraphs, with a rich annotation schema covering salient problem, solution, and rationale spans, solves and rationale_of links and conceptual coreference. A modular extraction pipeline scales this annotation to build a high-quality knowledge base of 37K source-grounded P-S-R triplets. We evaluate the extraction components and include a preliminary experiment training a rationale-supervised LLM for scientific problem solving. Interestingly, we find that rationale supervision improves performance on complex, multi-constraint problems but can harm performance on simpler ones.
articles.titleCn: MUSE：一个涵盖科学问题、解决方案及理由的全文本跨领域知识库
articles.abstractCn: 科学论文包含着精细的问题解决记录：作者提及了用于解决技术障碍的方法，并常常附上选择这些方法的理由。我们介绍了MUSE（挖掘潜在科学解释），这是一个全文本、多领域的科学问题-解决方案-理由（P-S-R）三元组资源。我们整理了579个专家标注的全文本段落，其丰富的标注模式涵盖了显著问题、解决方案和理由的跨度、解决方案与理由之间的链接以及概念共指。一个模块化的提取流程将这种标注扩展，构建了一个包含37K个来源关联的P-S-R三元组的高质量知识库。我们评估了提取组件，并包含了一项初步实验，用于训练一个用于科学问题解决的推理监督大型语言模型。有趣的是，我们发现推理监督可以提高复杂、多约束问题的性能，但在简单问题上可能会损害性能。

articles.title: ReLTEx: Reliable LLM-based Taxonomy Expansion
articles.abstract: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in generating semantically relevant concepts and relations, making them promising tools for taxonomy enrichment. However, directly relying on LLM-generated expansions often leads to noisy, redundant, or hierarchically inconsistent structures, limiting their reliability for automated taxonomy expansion. In this paper, we present ReLTEx, a framework for reliable LLM-based taxonomy expansion. ReLTEx combines LLM-driven candidate generation with structure-aware validation and recursive expansion control to improve the consistency and quality of generated taxonomies by reducing hallucinations. We evaluate the proposed framework using benchmark taxonomies under a masked taxonomy expansion setting and compare multiple validation strategies. Experimental results, supported by both adapted evaluation metrics and human evaluation, demonstrate that ReLTEx produces more reliable and semantically coherent taxonomy expansions.
articles.titleCn: ReLTEx：基于可靠LLM的分类体系扩展
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）的最新进展在生成语义相关的概念和关系方面展现出强大能力，使其成为分类体系丰富化的有力工具。然而，直接依赖LLM生成的扩展往往会导致噪声、冗余或层级不一致的结构，限制了其在自动化分类体系扩展中的可靠性。在本文中，我们提出了ReLTEx，一个基于LLM的可信赖分类体系扩展框架。ReLTEx结合了LLM驱动的候选生成、结构感知验证和递归扩展控制，通过减少幻觉来提高生成分类体系的连贯性和质量。我们使用掩码分类体系扩展设置下的基准分类体系评估了所提出的框架，并比较了多种验证策略。实验结果，结合改进的评价指标和人工评估，证明ReLTEx能够生成更可靠、语义更连贯的分类体系扩展。

articles.title: REAP: Relation-Aware Elicitation and Parsing for Closed-Book Knowledge Base Construction from LLMs
articles.abstract: We present the REAP system for the AKBC Shared Task 2026 on constructing knowledge bases from language models in a closed-book setting, subject to a budget of at most 32B parameters and no model fine-tuning. Our system combines structured chain-of-thought reasoning, relation-specific query strategies, and a reasoning-based empty-set gate to elicit parametric knowledge, followed by direct extraction into valid JSON arrays. On the test set, the system, built on the Mistral-Small-24B-Instruct-2501 model, achieves a macro-F1 score of 0.62, with particularly strong results on countryLandBordersCountry (F1 = 0.95), companyTradesAtStockExchange (F1 = 0.73), and hasArea (F1 = 0.77). Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/yammdd/AKBC-Shared-Task-2026.
articles.titleCn: REAP：基于关系感知的闭卷知识库构建从大型语言模型中提取和解析
articles.abstractCn: 我们为AKBC共享任务2026提出了REAP系统，该系统旨在从语言模型中构建知识库，且在闭卷设置下，参数预算不超过32B，且不允许模型微调。我们的系统结合了结构化思维链推理、关系特定查询策略以及基于推理的空集门来提取参数化知识，随后直接提取为有效的JSON数组。在测试集上，基于Mistral-Small-24B-Instruct-2501模型的系统，宏观F1得分为0.62，在countryLandBordersCountry（F1=0.95）、companyTradesAtStockExchange（F1=0.73）和hasArea（F1=0.77）等关系上表现尤为突出。我们的代码已公开发布在https://github.com/yammdd/AKBC-Shared-Task-2026。

articles.title: StreamFlow: Dynamic Memory Flows for Streaming Video Understanding
articles.abstract: Streaming video understanding requires multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to preserve relevant evidence from continuously evolving streams under strict causality and bounded memory. Yet existing paradigms remain limited: model-based methods require intrusive backbone updates, while memory-based methods expend substantial visual-encoding computation on temporally redundant content and rely on rigid access to visual history. To address these limitations, we introduce StreamFlow, an efficient visual memory framework that enables dynamic, on-demand access to historical visual information. StreamFlow combines a lightweight, dynamics-aware mid-term memory that filters temporal redundancy before visual encoding with a latent long-term memory that consolidates historical video content into visual latents accessible to subsequent reasoning. During generation, an attention-guided retrieval mechanism injects relevant visual latents when the model's reliance on visual evidence weakens. StreamFlow achieves state-of-the-art streaming video understanding performance, reaching 67.73% overall accuracy on StreamingBench, while also delivering strong performance on offline long-video benchmarks. Relative to the vanilla setting, it improves the visual attention score (VAS) by 59.1% while reducing end-to-end latency and peak memory by 50.4% and 21.1%, respectively, enabling more visually grounded and efficient reasoning.
articles.titleCn: StreamFlow：流媒体视频理解的动态内存流
articles.abstractCn: 流媒体视频理解需要多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）在严格的因果关系和有限的记忆条件下，保留从不断演变的流中获取的相关证据。然而，现有范式仍然存在局限：基于模型的方法需要侵入式的主干更新，而基于记忆的方法则在时间冗余内容上消耗大量视觉编码计算，并依赖于对视觉历史的刚性访问。为解决这些局限，我们引入了StreamFlow，一个高效的视觉记忆框架，它能够实现动态、按需访问历史视觉信息。StreamFlow结合了一个轻量级、感知动态的中期记忆，该记忆在视觉编码前过滤时间冗余，以及一个潜在的长期记忆，它将历史视频内容整合为后续推理可访问的视觉潜在表示。在生成过程中，一个注意力引导的检索机制在模型对视觉证据的依赖减弱时注入相关的视觉潜在表示。StreamFlow实现了流媒体视频理解的最优性能，在StreamingBench上达到了67.73%的整体准确率，同时在离线长视频基准测试中也表现出色。相对于基础设置，它将视觉注意力分数（VAS）提高了59.1%，同时将端到端延迟和峰值内存分别降低了50.4%和21.1%，从而实现了更基于视觉和高效的推理。

articles.title: MobileMem: Learning from a Year of Mobile Experiences
articles.abstract: The next generation of AI agents is increasingly moving beyond systems that answer isolated questions toward persistent personal assistants that can understand, remember, and continuously learn from users' experiences. Such assistants require long-term memory to accumulate and leverage user-specific experiences over time, yet existing benchmarks remain inadequate for realistic mobile settings, where experiences are heterogeneous, multimodal, evolving, and deeply personal. We introduce MobileMem, a benchmark and framework for studying on-device long-term memory, grounded in a year-scale collection of mobile experiences. MobileMem employs a knowledge-grounded synthesis pipeline to construct coherent and temporally consistent long-horizon trajectories from user-app sessions. It provides complementary text and multimodal settings covering multi-hop and temporal reasoning, knowledge updating, and implicit preference inference. Specifically, MobileMem enables agents to remember the past, understand the present, and adapt to the future. By modeling experiences rather than isolated facts, MobileMem moves memory beyond information retrieval toward experiential intelligence for continuous personal learning.
articles.titleCn: MobileMem：从一年的移动体验中学习
articles.abstractCn: 下一代AI代理正越来越多地从回答孤立问题的系统转向能够理解、记忆并持续从用户经验中学习的持久性个人助理。这类助理需要长期记忆来积累和利用随时间推移的用户特定经验，但现有的基准测试仍然不足以满足现实移动环境的需求，因为移动环境中的经验具有异构性、多模态性、动态变化性和高度个性化。我们介绍了MobileMem，这是一个基于为期一年规模的移动经验收集的、用于研究设备端长期记忆的基准测试和框架。MobileMem采用基于知识的合成流程，从用户应用会话中构建连贯且时间一致的长期轨迹。它提供了互补的文本和多模态场景，涵盖多跳推理、知识更新和隐式偏好推断。具体而言，MobileMem使代理能够记住过去、理解现在并适应未来。通过模拟经验而非孤立事实，MobileMem将记忆从信息检索推向体验智能，以实现持续的个人学习。

articles.title: A Cost-Efficient Routing Pipeline for Multilingual Short-Text Classification Using Small Language Models
articles.abstract: Multilingual short-text classification supports operational systems such as content moderation, customer support routing, and intent recognition, yet aggregate evaluation often hides large differences between high-resource and low-resource languages. Uniform inference policies are simple to deploy, but they assume that all languages are equally well served. In this work, we evaluate a fixed-list routing strategy that keeps stronger languages on a direct multilingual path and selectively sends weaker languages through translation into English before zero-shot classification. The pipeline is fully self-hosted, uses pretrained compact sentence encoders, and requires no task-specific fine-tuning. We test the approach on two benchmarks chosen to differ in scale and label granularity: a 15-language subset of SIB-200 for seven-way topic classification and a 15-locale subset of MASSIVE for intent classification over an official 60-intent inventory. On SIB-200, the best overall configuration is R1, which translates only the low-resource tier: high-tier and mid-tier Macro-F1 remain unchanged, while low-tier Macro-F1 rises from 0.4632 to 0.6828. On the MASSIVE subset, the same low-tier intervention raises low-tier Macro-F1 from 0.2143 to 0.4417, but the best overall result is obtained by full translation, R3, at Macro-F1 0.4647. Across these two benchmarks, selective translation is a reliable intervention for weaker languages, whereas the optimal routing boundary depends on the task. We therefore report routing through tier-level quality gains and tier-level latency rather than a single global efficiency score.
articles.comment: Accepted for publication at the 16th International Conference on Advanced Computer Information Technologies (ACIT 2026), https://acit.tech/
articles.titleCn: 一种用于多语言短文本分类的小型语言模型的成本效益路由管道
articles.abstractCn: 多语言短文本分类支持内容审核、客户支持路由和意图识别等操作系统，但总体评估常掩盖高资源语言和低资源语言之间的大型差异。统一推理策略易于部署，但假设所有语言都得到同等服务。在本工作中，我们评估了一种固定列表路由策略，该策略将强语言保留在直接的多语言路径上，并选择性地将弱语言通过翻译成英语后再进行零样本分类。该流程完全自托管，使用预训练的紧凑句子编码器，且无需特定任务的微调。我们在两个基准数据集上测试该方法，这两个基准数据集在规模和标签粒度上有所不同：一个是在SIB-200的15语言子集上进行七分类主题分类，另一个是在MASSIVE的15地区子集上进行基于官方60意图清单的意图分类。在SIB-200上，最佳整体配置是R1，它仅翻译低资源层：高资源层和中等资源层的Macro-F1保持不变，而低资源层的Macro-F1从0.4632提升到0.6828。在MASSIVE子集上，同样的低资源层干预将低资源层的Macro-F1从0.2143提升到0.4417，但最佳整体结果是由完全翻译的R3获得，Macro-F1为0.4647。在这两个基准数据集上，选择性翻译是对弱语言的可靠干预，而最佳路由边界取决于任务。因此，我们报告通过层级质量提升和层级延迟进行路由，而不是单一的全球效率分数。

articles.title: FaithformBench: Benchmarking Faithfulness of Mathematical Chain-of-Thought Autoformalisation
articles.abstract: Autoformalisation (AF) systems map natural language reasoning steps into formal statements in a proof assistant such as Lean. We consider how to assess the faithfulness of these systems. Existing approaches require expensive human-annotated ground truth, or rely on LLM judges or embedding models, which come with limited guarantees of accuracy. In addition, these methods typically only consider inputs that are known to be correct, and therefore do not assess whether the AF translates incorrect inputs faithfully. To address these limitations, we propose a new benchmark for AF faithfulness that is cheap to apply, sound under weak assumptions, and assesses both positive and negative examples. Our method is based on automatically generating perturbed reasoning steps that are designed to be invalid, and then measuring validity preservation on unperturbed steps and invalidity preservation on perturbed steps. We apply our method to eight AF systems across four mathematical datasets, and observe pervasive sycophancy: many AFs "silently correct" invalid inputs into provable statements. The most validity-preserving fine-tuned AFs are also the most sycophantic, suggesting a tension between validity and invalidity preservation in current AF systems.
articles.titleCn: FaithformBench：数学思维链自动形式化忠实度基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 自动形式化（AF）系统将自然语言推理步骤映射到证明助手（如Lean）中的形式化声明。我们探讨了如何评估这些系统的忠实度。现有方法需要昂贵的人工标注基准，或依赖于大型语言模型（LLM）裁判或嵌入模型，这些方法在准确性方面存在有限的保证。此外，这些方法通常只考虑已知正确的输入，因此无法评估AF是否忠实地将错误输入转换为形式化声明。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了一种新的AF忠实度基准，该基准易于应用，在弱假设下具有可靠性，并能评估正面和负面示例。我们的方法基于自动生成旨在无效的扰动推理步骤，然后测量未扰动步骤的有效性保持以及扰动步骤的无效性保持。我们将该方法应用于四个数学数据集上的八个AF系统，观察到普遍的奉承现象：许多AF系统“无声地纠正”无效输入为可证明的声明。最能有效保持的微调AF系统也是最奉承的，这表明当前AF系统在有效性保持和无效性保持之间存在矛盾。

articles.title: Order Matters: LVLMs as Judges for Temporal Reasoning in Image Sequences
articles.abstract: As generative multimedia evolves from static image synthesis to complex, interleaved visual narratives, a foundational bottleneck has emerged: the judgment crisis. While human perception naturally synthesizes the temporal and logical flow of a story, automated evaluation systems remain largely "blind" to sequential continuity, often failing to distinguish between a coherent narrative and a semantically shuffled or contradictory sequence. This work identifies a critical structural gap in current multimodal evaluation paradigms, arguing that the reliance on Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) as judges is fundamentally limited by architectural biases. Our analysis reveals a profound performance dichotomy: while models may appear competent in isolated pointwise scoring, they suffer a catastrophic collapse when required to perform pairwise discrimination of temporal order. We demonstrate that this is not merely a data-scarcity issue but a structural one. Through a series of diagnostic probes, we uncover systematic positional asymmetries, specifically primacy and recency effects, where a model's judgment of a story is significantly influenced by the placement of a frame, often more than by its semantic consistency. These biases, potentially rooted in causal masking and rotary embeddings, suggest that current transformer-based judges are inherently ill-equipped for long-form visual reasoning. By exposing these blind spots, we challenge the multimedia community to move beyond snapshot-centric metrics and instead pioneer Temporally-Aware Evaluation paradigms that treat visual sequences as unified logical structures rather than unordered collections of frames.
articles.titleCn: 顺序很重要：LVLMs作为图像序列中时间推理的裁判
articles.abstractCn: 随着生成式多媒体从静态图像合成发展到复杂的、交织的视觉叙事，一个基础性的瓶颈已经出现：评判危机。虽然人类感知能够自然地合成故事的时间和逻辑流程，但自动化评估系统在序列连续性方面仍然存在“盲点”，常常无法区分连贯的叙事与语义打乱或矛盾序列。这项工作指出了当前多模态评估范式中的一个关键结构性缺陷，认为依赖大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）作为评判者从根本上受到架构偏见的限制。我们的分析揭示了一种深刻的性能二分法：虽然模型在孤立的单点评分中可能表现出色，但在要求进行时间顺序的成对区分时却会遭遇灾难性的崩溃。我们证明这不仅仅是数据稀缺问题，而是一个结构性问题。通过一系列诊断探测，我们发现了系统性的位置不对称性，特别是首位效应和近因效应，即模型对故事的评判会受到帧放置位置的显著影响，这种影响往往超过其语义一致性。这些偏见可能源于因果掩码和旋转嵌入，表明基于Transformer的当前评判者天生不适用于长篇视觉推理。通过揭示这些盲点，我们挑战多媒体界超越以快照为中心的指标，转而开创时间感知评估范式，将视觉序列视为统一的逻辑结构，而非无序的帧集合。

articles.title: Certify or Refuse: A Cross-Model Map for Selective Risk Control with Coverage Floors under Covariate Shift
articles.abstract: Certified selective predictors attain whatever coverage they attain; operators impose an automation floor: answer at least a $β$-fraction of shifted target traffic with at most an $α$-fraction of answers wrong. Under bounded-ratio covariate shift we prove the Floor Certification Map: once that floor must be certified alongside the selection-conditioned risk $α$, certification acquires a feasibility frontier and a two-resource complexity map, additive up to constants: risk in labeled source, the floor in unlabeled target samples. The rates are local, needing a regular frontier margin, slack below the local-regime threshold, and lattice conditions: pre-registered with a lattice margin for the upper bounds, compatible per-slack for the lower. The displayed split is the operational route; oracle weights also allow a labeled-source floor estimate. Three model-tagged results: a lower bound (Model-B), a matching oracle-weight upper bound (Model-A), and an implementable upper bound (Model-B') valid under a pre-registered exact stratified-shift model with nuisance cost priced explicitly. The match is across these models rather than a single-model minimax theorem, and necessarily so: over the full bounded-ratio class no unknown-weight procedure matches at any sample size (Model-B is inconsistent, witnessed at $α=β=1/2$). The nuisance's necessity is only partially settled. Complexity tracks a localized accepted-region functional, not global effective sample size (ESS), on both sides, though a fixed-ESS separation theorem is left open; both lower-bound axes vanish as $β\to0$, so the floor creates the map. Empirically, the registered bite family diverges with log-log slope $-2.002$ within its pre-registered band; a 1,024-cell audit records 0 violations where the formal certificates fire; and a single-corpus SQuAD-to-NewsQA feasibility audit returns honest refusal.
articles.titleCn: 认证或拒绝：在协变量偏移下具有覆盖底线的选择性风险控制跨模型映射
articles.abstractCn: 认证的选择性预测器能够达到其所能达到的覆盖范围；算子施加了一个自动化下限：至少以$\beta$分数回答偏移目标流量，且错误回答不超过$\alpha$分数。在有限比率协变量偏移下，我们证明了下限认证映射：一旦必须认证下限以及选择条件下的风险$\alpha$，认证就获得了一个可行性前沿和一个两资源复杂度映射，其增量仅受常数影响：风险在标记源中，下限在未标记目标样本中。这些比率是局部的，需要定期前沿边界、低于局部状态阈值下的松弛，以及格条件：预先注册的格边界用于上限，每个松弛兼容于下限。显示的分割是操作路径；神谕权重也允许标记源下限估计。三个模型标记结果：一个下限（模型-B）、一个匹配神谕权重上限（模型-A），以及一个可实现的、在预先注册的精确分层偏移模型下有效且明确计价干扰成本的上限（模型-B'）。匹配是在这些模型之间而非单一模型的 minimax 定理，且必然如此：在完整的有限比率类中，任何样本大小下没有未知权重程序能够匹配（模型-B 是不一致的，在$\alpha=\beta=1/2$时得到证明）。干扰的必要性只是部分解决。复杂度跟踪局部接受区域函数，而非全局有效样本量（ESS），在两边都是如此，尽管一个固定 ESS 分离定理留待解决；两个下限轴随着$\beta\to0$而消失，因此下限创造了映射。经验上，注册的咬合家族在其预先注册带内以对数-对数斜率$-2.002$发散；一个包含1024个单元的审计在正式证书触发时记录了0次违规；单一语料库的 SQuAD 到 NewsQA 可行性审计返回了诚实的拒绝。

articles.title: X2-Turn: Frame-Synchronous Dual-Head Modeling for Joint Streaming ASR and Turn State Prediction
articles.abstract: Accurate and responsive turn-taking is essential for spoken dialogue systems, which must distinguish in real time between user interruptions, backchannels that should be ignored, and the completion of an utterance. Prior modular approaches typically optimize turn state prediction at the utterance or fixed-chunk level, creating a mismatch with the continuous turn state estimate, and often depend on an auxiliary ASR model, which limits responsiveness and increases overall system complexity. Therefore, we present X2-Turn, a frame-synchronous turn state prediction method via delayed-stream modeling. Specifically, building on the pretrained Voxtral Realtime model, we introduce a frame-synchronous turn state head that operates in parallel with the ASR head on shared streaming representations, jointly predicting ASR tokens and fine-grained turn states at the frame level. We evaluate our method on the bilingual Chinese-English Easy-Turn test sets, and the results demonstrate its effectiveness in achieving accurate turn-taking detection while maintaining low latency.
articles.titleCn: X2-Turn：用于联合流式语音识别和转向状态预测的帧同步双头建模
articles.abstractCn: 精确且及时的轮流发言对于口语对话系统至关重要，这些系统必须在实时中区分用户打断、应被忽略的回声通道以及语句的完成。先前的模块化方法通常在语句或固定块级别优化轮流状态预测，这与连续的轮流状态估计存在不匹配，并且通常依赖于一个辅助的语音识别模型，这限制了响应能力并增加了整体系统复杂性。因此，我们提出了X2-Turn，一种通过延迟流建模实现的帧同步轮流状态预测方法。具体而言，基于预训练的Voxtral Realtime模型，我们引入了一个与语音识别头并行运行的帧同步轮流状态头，在共享的流表示上联合预测语音识别标记和细粒度的轮流状态。我们在双语中文-英语Easy-Turn测试集上评估了我们的方法，结果证明了它在实现精确轮流发言检测的同时保持低延迟的有效性。

articles.title: VibeLifeBench: Can Your Life Agent Be Proactive and Persistent in a Living World?
articles.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed as personal assistants. Existing evaluations, however, mostly use short, self-contained requests in static environments. Everyday life assistance is different. A task runs for weeks rather than minutes. The world keeps changing while the agent is not being prompted. Many constraints are never stated outright. An agent that merely answers the request in front of it will fail at such a task. What is needed instead is an agent that stays proactive and consistent. It decides on its own when to act, when to ask, and when to stay silent. It notices changes that nobody announced. It keeps one plan coherent from the first day to the last. No current benchmark measures this. We introduce VibeLifeBench, a benchmark of 200 long-horizon tasks across ten everyday-life domains. Each task is a scripted multi-week timeline in a simulated world of 22 mock services. The world advances on its own clock, and many of its changes are silent, so only an agent that re-inspects the world discovers them. Every task is graded by fine-grained, weighted checks that read only what the agent actually left behind, covering the end state, the timeliness of its actions, and whether it upheld the implicit constraints. We evaluate seven frontier models. All of them score low, which shows how far current agents are from assisting with real life. We will open-source all tasks, environments, and the evaluation framework.
articles.titleCn: VibeLifeBench：您的生命代理在真实世界中能否主动且坚持？
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）代理正越来越多地被用作个人助手。然而，现有的评估方法大多在静态环境中使用简短、自包含的请求。日常生活辅助则截然不同。一项任务可能持续数周而非数分钟。当代理未被提示时，世界仍在不断变化。许多约束条件从未被明确说明。仅仅回答眼前请求的代理将无法完成此类任务。相反，我们需要的是一种积极主动且保持一致的代理。它自行决定何时行动、何时提问以及何时保持沉默。它能注意到无人宣布的变化。它能从第一天到最后一日保持计划的一致性。目前没有任何基准测试能够衡量这一点。我们介绍了VibeLifeBench，这是一个涵盖十个日常生活领域的200个长期任务基准测试。每个任务都是一个在包含22个模拟服务的虚拟世界中持续多周的脚本化时间线。世界按照自己的时钟推进，许多变化是静默的，只有重新检查世界的代理才能发现它们。每个任务都通过细粒度、加权的检查进行评分，这些检查只读取代理实际留下的内容，涵盖最终状态、其行动的及时性以及是否遵守了隐含约束。我们评估了七个前沿模型。所有模型得分均较低，这表明当前代理距离真正辅助日常生活还有多远。我们将开源所有任务、环境和评估框架。

articles.title: Reference-Free Post-Training of Open Large Language Models for Multilingual Machine Translation
articles.abstract: We study reference-free post-training for multilingual machine translation with open large language models. Starting from the supervised-finetuned MiLMMT-46-v0.1 models, we apply Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with a reward that averages two reference-free quality estimation models and is gated by language identification. We then linearly interpolate the supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) model checkpoints to obtain MiLMMT-46-v1.0. Across 46 languages, the resulting models consistently improve translation quality over their SFT counterparts, outperform strong recent open baselines, including Seed-X, HY-MT2, and TranslateGemma, and achieve leading reference-free scores against evaluated proprietary systems such as Google Translate, Gemini 3 Pro, and GPT-5. We further investigate on-policy distillation (OPD) and find that it reaches, but does not surpass, the quality frontier achieved by RL with checkpoint interpolation. We release the models and code to facilitate future research.
articles.titleCn: 无参考的多语言机器翻译开放大型语言模型的训练后微调
articles.abstractCn: 我们研究了基于开放大型语言模型的免参考多语言机器翻译的免参考后训练方法。从监督微调的MiLMMT-46-v0.1模型开始，我们应用了具有语言识别门控的、平均两个免参考质量评估模型的奖励的组相对策略优化（GRPO）。然后，我们将监督微调（SFT）和强化学习（RL）模型检查点线性插值，以获得MiLMMT-46-v1.0模型。在46种语言中，所得模型始终优于其SFT对应模型，超越了包括Seed-X、HY-MT2和TranslateGemma在内的强近期开放基线，并在Google翻译、Gemini 3 Pro和GPT-5等评估专有系统上取得了领先的免参考分数。我们进一步研究了策略蒸馏（OPD），发现它达到了但并未超越通过检查点插值实现的RL质量前沿。我们发布了模型和代码，以促进未来的研究。

articles.title: Surfacing the Unsaid: CUE-Bench for Affective Stance in Chinese Discourse
articles.abstract: Emotion understanding in discourse requires reasoning beyond surface sentiment because speakers often convey affect through indirect, implicit, polite, ironic, or deliberately mismatched expressions. Existing emotion benchmarks mainly annotate surface polarity or final emotion categories, while lacking a structured account of how explicit expression, implicit affect, pragmatic intent, and fine grained emotion interact. This limitation makes current evaluations insensitive to cases where affective meaning is concealed, weakened, inverted, or pragmatically reshaped, thereby obscuring model failures in deeper emotion understanding. To address this gap, we introduce CUE Bench, a Chinese Unsaid Emotion benchmark that centers on Affective Stance and covers diverse communicative scenarios. CUE Bench constructs nine human interpretable affective stances from explicit implicit polarity interaction and further provides intent and fine grained emotion annotations for structured affective inference. Experiments show that incorporating Affective Stance improves fine grained emotion recognition by 3.5 percentage points and pragmatic intent detection by 7.8 percentage points over strong baselines.
articles.titleCn: 浮现未言：中文话语情感立场CUE-Bench
articles.abstractCn: 话语中的情感理解需要超越表面情感进行推理，因为说话者常常通过间接、隐含、礼貌、讽刺或刻意错位的表达方式来传达情感。现有的情感基准主要标注表面极性或最终情感类别，而缺乏对显性表达、隐含情感、语用意图和细粒度情感之间相互作用的系统性描述。这一局限性使得当前评估对情感意义被隐藏、削弱、反转或语用重塑的情况不敏感，从而掩盖了模型在深层情感理解方面的缺陷。为解决这一差距，我们引入CUE基准，这是一个聚焦于情感立场并涵盖多样化交际场景的中文未言之情基准。CUE基准从显性隐含极性相互作用中构建了九种人类可解释的情感立场，并进一步提供意图和细粒度情感的标注，以支持结构化的情感推理。实验表明，引入情感立场使细粒度情感识别准确率提高了3.5个百分点，语用意图检测准确率提高了7.8个百分点，优于强基线模型。

articles.title: Assessing Reliability of BERT-Based Models on Question Answering Tasks
articles.abstract: Reliability estimation of large language models is in many cases as crucial as their accuracy, as reliable models are more trustworthy, robust, and suitable for practical applications. Recent advancements in natural language processing (NLP), particularly those based on transformer architectures, have significantly accelerated progress across various NLP tasks. This study focuses on the reliability of transformer-based question answering (QA) models, specifically BERT models and its variants (RoBERTa, ALBERT, DistilBERT). These encoder-only pretrained transformers have demonstrated remarkable accuracy in QA tasks that can be treated as classification tasks. However, their reliability remains underexplored. This study evaluates the reliability of four BERT-based models by assessing response stability under two conditions: (1) internal model variations induced via Monte Carlo Dropout (MCD) and (2) input perturbations through paraphrasing. Using the SQuAD and QuAC datasets, we investigate how dropout rates affect prediction consistency and whether lexical changes impact answer stability. Our findings reveal that RoBERTa maintains higher reliability, whereas AlBERT and DistilBERT exhibit significant inconsistencies. Statistical analyses confirm that enabling MCD during prediction does not disrupt inference dynamics, validating its effectiveness as a reliability metric. These findings underscore the importance of evaluating both accuracy and stability in QA models to ensure stability in real-world applications.
articles.comment: Accepted for publication in the Journal of Experimental & Theoretical Artificial Intelligence
articles.titleCn: 评估基于BERT的模型在问答任务上的可靠性
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型的可靠性在很多情况下与它们的准确性同等重要，因为可靠的模型更加值得信赖、稳健，并且更适合实际应用。自然语言处理（NLP）领域的最新进展，特别是基于Transformer架构的进展，显著加速了各种NLP任务的进展。本研究聚焦于基于Transformer的问答（QA）模型的可靠性，具体包括BERT模型及其变体（RoBERTa、ALBERT、DistilBERT）。这些仅包含编码器的预训练Transformer在可视为分类任务的QA任务中表现出色，但它们的可靠性仍待探索。本研究通过评估两种条件下的响应稳定性来评估四种基于BERT的模型的可靠性：（1）通过蒙特卡洛Dropout（MCD）诱导的内部模型变化；（2）通过释义引入的输入扰动。使用SQuAD和QuAC数据集，我们研究了dropout率如何影响预测一致性，以及词汇变化是否会影响答案稳定性。我们的研究发现RoBERTa保持了更高的可靠性，而ALBERT和DistilBERT表现出显著的不一致性。统计分析证实，在预测期间启用MCD不会破坏推理动态，验证了其作为可靠性指标的有效性。这些发现强调了在QA模型中评估准确性和稳定性的重要性，以确保在实际应用中的稳定性。

articles.title: Mitigating Context Interference for Reliable and Efficient Search Agents
articles.abstract: Recent research empowers Large Language Models (LLMs) as multi-turn search agents to iteratively retrieve and generate outputs until complex tasks are solved. However, the contexts of multi-turn search agents are lengthy and complex. For example, the retrieved set of documents in each turn would inevitably introduce irrelevant information that distracts LLMs, referring to \textit{context interference}, potentially hindering the reliability and efficiency of search agents. Therefore, we conduct a systematic study on context interference in multi-turn search agents, focusing on investigating i) which parts of the context of search agents will contribute to the context interference, ii) how to refine the contexts of search agents to mitigate the interference, and iii) can incorporating context refinement into search agent training yield further improvements. We reveal that interference primarily arises from the latest retrieved documents. Based on the explored findings, we then introduce a distill-based context refiner to dynamically mitigate context interference for multi-turn search agents. Finally, we validate that incorporating context refinement into RL training pipelines of search agents can significantly enhance both reliability and efficiency. This study highlights the importance of mitigating context interference of search agents, inspiring a novel paradigm of ``refine context and then generate'' for AI agents.
articles.titleCn: 缓解上下文干扰，以实现可靠高效的搜索代理
articles.abstractCn: 近期研究使大型语言模型（LLMs）成为多轮搜索代理，通过迭代检索和生成输出直至解决复杂任务。然而，多轮搜索代理的上下文漫长且复杂。例如，每轮检索到的文档集合不可避免地会引入无关信息，分散LLMs的注意力，即所谓的“上下文干扰”，可能影响搜索代理的可靠性和效率。因此，我们对多轮搜索代理中的上下文干扰进行了系统研究，重点关注调查：i）搜索代理的哪些上下文部分会导致上下文干扰，ii）如何优化搜索代理的上下文以减轻干扰，以及iii）将上下文优化纳入搜索代理训练是否还能进一步提升效果。我们发现干扰主要源于最新检索到的文档。基于这些发现，我们引入了一种基于蒸馏的上下文优化器，以动态减轻多轮搜索代理的上下文干扰。最后，我们验证了将上下文优化纳入搜索代理的强化学习训练流程可以显著提升可靠性和效率。这项研究强调了减轻搜索代理上下文干扰的重要性，启发了一种新的“先优化上下文再生成”的人工智能代理范式。

articles.title: When Is a General Factor Distinguishable? Non-Proportionality, Stable Structure, and the Bifactor Decision
articles.abstract: Whether an additional general dimension is necessary beyond correlated first-order factors is a property of the population covariance matrix, not of any estimator or design. This research establishes when that property can be decided. Where the general and group loadings are proportional within every cluster the bifactor structure is covariance-equivalent to correlated factors, so no sample size separates them (Proposition 1); where that proportionality fails in every cluster, three items per cluster and some mild regularities leave no $K$-factor model with diagonal uniquenesses able to reproduce the covariance matrix (Theorem 1); and between them lies a mixed boundary, located numerically here and turning on cluster resistance. Distinguishability is therefore graded, measured by the population distance to the $K$-factor class. Because that question is conditional on a first-order structure which is itself uncertain, a two-step procedure is developed within partially exploratory factor analysis, delivering a structure only when it reproduces across adjacent counts and treating non-delivery as legitimate. Simulation shows that a unanimous count can accompany a structure that fails to reproduce, and that absorbed local dependence can imitate a general factor, the error growing with sample size while stability indicators stay clean. Four empirical datasets illustrate the possible outcomes.
articles.titleCn: 何时一个一般因素可被区分？非比例性、稳定结构与双因素决策
articles.abstractCn: 在相关一阶因子之外是否需要额外的通用维度，是总体协方差矩阵的特性，而非任何估计器或设计的特性。本研究确立了何时可以判定该特性。当通用因子载荷和组载荷在每个聚类中成比例时，双因子结构在协方差上等同于相关因子，因此没有样本量能将它们区分开来（命题1）；当每个聚类中都不满足这种比例关系时，每个聚类三个项目及一些轻微的规律性使得没有具有对角唯一性的K因子模型能够再现协方差矩阵（定理1）；而两者之间存在一个混合边界，其数值位置在此处确定，并取决于聚类的抗性。因此可区分性是分级的，通过总体与K因子类的距离来衡量。由于该问题本身取决于不确定的一阶结构，在部分探索性因子分析中开发了一种两步程序，仅在结构能跨相邻计数再现时才输出结构，并将无法再现视为有效。模拟表明，一致的计数可能伴随无法再现的结构，而吸收的局部依赖可能模仿通用因子，误差随样本量增大而增加，而稳定性指标保持清晰。四个实证数据集说明了可能的结果。

articles.title: Ex-Omni-2D: Expressive Omni-Modal Dialogue Models with Native Visual Presence
articles.abstract: Omni-modal dialogue models can understand multimodal inputs and synthesize spoken replies, yet their responses remain visually disembodied. We introduce \textbf{Ex-Omni-2D}, an omni-modal dialogue framework that generates a coordinated response comprising text, personalized speech, and reference-conditioned video. Given a multimodal query, reference image, and reference audio, the model predicts a structured \textit{Visual Thought Plan} (VTP) describing scene, emotion, and motion, followed by response text and native multi-codebook speech units. These units form a shared acoustic-temporal interface: they are decoded into speech and aligned online with video frames. This interface enables the response and avatar pathways to be learned from heterogeneous speech, dialogue, and avatar-video data, avoiding the need for large-scale query--text--speech--video supervision. A full-sequence Video Generator serves as the primary Teacher. For efficient incremental generation, we further distill it into a few-step block-causal \emph{Streaming Student} whose Prefix Streaming mechanism carries a clean latent across consecutive chunks to reduce cumulative late-chunk degradation. With four-step inference, the complete four-GPU pipeline achieves an end-to-end RTF of 1.293 at $400\times720$/$720\times400$, providing a practical quality--efficiency operating point.
articles.titleCn: 前Omni-2D：具有原生视觉呈现的通用多模态对话模型
articles.abstractCn: 全模态对话模型能够理解多模态输入并合成语音回复，但其响应在视觉上仍然缺乏实体感。我们引入了\textbf{Ex-Omni-2D}，这是一个全模态对话框架，能够生成包含文本、个性化语音和参考条件视频的协调响应。给定多模态查询、参考图像和参考音频，模型首先预测一个结构化的\textit{视觉思维计划}（VTP），描述场景、情感和动作，然后生成响应文本和原生多码本语音单元。这些单元构成一个共享的声学-时间接口：它们被解码为语音，并实时与视频帧对齐。该接口使得响应和虚拟形象路径能够从异构的语音、对话和虚拟形象-视频数据中学习，避免了大规模查询-文本-语音-视频监督的需求。一个全序列视频生成器作为主要的教师。为了实现高效的增量生成，我们进一步将其蒸馏为一个几步的块因果\emph{流式学生}，其前缀流机制将干净的潜空间传递到连续的块中，以减少累积的后期块退化。通过四步推理，完整的四GPU流水线在$400\times720$/$720\times400$分辨率下实现了1.293的端到端RTF，提供了一个实用的质量-效率操作点。

articles.title: DuplexWorld: Can voice agents help you get through the day?
articles.abstract: Speech-to-speech (S2S) voice agents are increasingly being incorporated into enterprise for customer care and as daily companions for consumers owing to the ease of the conversational modality over text. However, existing benchmarks fail to holistically evaluate voice agents along axes that really matter and are shaped as tests of agentic tool calling against a database. We believe they fail to adequately account for the diversity of conversational dialogue that mundane activities introduce and further, never test how faithfully an agent can assist on tasks that move beyond database manipulation. To tackle this DuplexWorld introduces six worlds where voice agents are especially useful: banking, insurance, travel, healthcare and logistics, and Pathfinding. Agents are evaluated on eleven different types of conversations across 156 scenarios (350+ hours of conversation), each testing conversational and analytical capability to varying degrees. Through extensive evaluation comprising agentic, conversational and speech-naturalness metrics, we show that even the best voice agents leave substantial room for improvement on all 3 axes (Pass@1: 0.490, turn-taking: 0.653, DNSMOS: 3.378). We perform extensive analysis on agentic v conversational performance, world- and conversation type-wise performance, failure modes exploring the explore v exploit lens for Pathfinding conversations and voice agent reliability over all six worlds.
articles.titleCn: DuplexWorld：语音助手能帮你度过这一天吗？
articles.abstractCn: 由于对话模式的便捷性，语音到语音（S2S）语音代理正越来越多地被集成到企业中用于客户服务，并作为消费者的日常伴侣。然而，现有的基准测试未能从真正重要的维度全面评估语音代理，其形式为针对数据库的代理工具调用测试。我们认为，它们未能充分考虑到日常活动引入的对话对话多样性，并且从未测试过代理在超越数据库操作的任务上提供帮助的忠实度。为了应对这一挑战，DuplexWorld引入了六个特别适用于语音代理的世界：银行、保险、旅游、医疗保健和物流，以及寻路。代理在156个场景（350多小时对话）中的11种不同类型的对话中进行评估，每种对话都在不同程度上测试了对话和分析能力。通过包含代理能力、对话能力和语音自然度指标的综合评估，我们表明，即使是最好的语音代理在所有三个维度上仍有巨大的改进空间（Pass@1：0.490，轮流发言：0.653，DNSMOS：3.378）。我们对代理能力与对话能力、按世界和对话类型进行的性能、探索与利用视角下的寻路对话失败模式以及所有六个世界中的语音代理可靠性进行了深入分析。

articles.title: Most biomedical publications show signs of LLM-assisted writing
articles.abstract: Over the past several years, LLM-powered chatbots and agents have become widely used as a tool for academic writing. LLM-assisted writing can be valuable by removing language barriers but at the same time causes concerns about misconduct and fraud. To inform policy decisions, it is necessary to monitor the prevalence of LLM-altered texts in scholarly publications. Despite some recent progress in this direction, no existing method can produce reliable estimates. Here we suggest and validate a new unbiased approach to estimate LLM usage in a corpus of texts based on changing word frequencies. We apply our method to the full texts of open-access biomedical papers from Pubmed Central, and show that by the end of 2025, 89% of papers show excess of LLM-associated vocabulary. We also find that LLMs are twice as likely to be used when writing a paragraph in the Discussion section (68%) compared to a paragraph in the Methods section (32%), but even inside the Methods section, the overall prevalence of LLM usage is over 50%. We believe that our estimates are crucial to shape future guidelines and policies.
articles.titleCn: 大多数生物医学出版物显示出使用大型语言模型辅助写作的迹象
articles.abstractCn: 在过去的几年里，基于大型语言模型的聊天机器人和智能体已成为学术写作的重要工具。通过消除语言障碍，LLM辅助写作具有价值，但同时也引发了关于不当行为和欺诈的担忧。为了制定政策决策，有必要监控学术出版物中LLM修改文本的普遍程度。尽管在这一方向上取得了一些近期进展，但现有方法都无法提供可靠的估计。在此，我们提出并验证了一种基于词频变化的新无偏方法，用于估计文本语料库中LLM的使用情况。我们将该方法应用于PubMed Central上开放获取生物医学论文的全文，并表明到2025年底，89%的论文显示出超出LLM相关词汇量的情况。我们还发现，在讨论部分撰写段落时使用LLM的可能性是方法部分的两倍（讨论部分为68%，方法部分为32%），但在方法部分，LLM使用的总体普遍率仍然超过50%。我们相信，我们的估计对于塑造未来的指南和政策至关重要。

articles.title: Your LLM, Your Style: Behavioral Mode Axes for LLM Behavioral Control
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly act in interactive settings where their behavioral styles affect user experience, safety, and downstream decision making. Existing LLM personality studies largely rely on self-report questionnaires administered in first-person settings, making the resulting profiles sensitive to surface elicitation choices and poorly grounded in concrete model behavior. In this work, we introduce a situated behavioral-data (B-data) framework for studying and controlling LLM behavioral personality. We construct 3,200 contrastive behavioral scenarios spanning 20 behavioral patterns and four prompt registers, grounded in validated psychometric facets such as BFI-2, DOSPERT, and HEXACO. Using this framework, we find that LLMs exhibit stable and model-specific behavioral profiles, while also revealing register-dependent shifts across first-person decisions, advice-giving, and task execution. We then show that these behavioral patterns can be controlled through Behavioral Mode Axes (BMAs), activation-space directions derived from contrastive behavioral traces. Compared with response-derived BMAs, which are more prone to trait drift, thought-derived BMAs more faithfully capture the intended behavioral mechanism and provide cleaner control over situated behavioral styles. Our results suggest that LLM personality-like tendencies are better understood not as abstract self-report traits, but as measurable and controllable behavioral modes grounded in concrete interaction contexts. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/lhz191/LLM-Behavioral-Personality.
articles.titleCn: 您的LLM，您的风格：用于LLM行为控制的模式轴
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地应用于交互式场景中，其行为风格会影响用户体验、安全性和下游决策。现有的LLM人格研究主要依赖于第一人称场景下的自我报告问卷，导致生成的用户画像容易受到表面诱导选择的影响，且与具体的模型行为缺乏实证基础。在本工作中，我们引入了一种情境行为数据（B-data）框架，用于研究和控制LLM的行为人格。我们构建了3200个对比行为场景，涵盖20种行为模式和四种提示注册方式，这些场景基于经过验证的心理测量维度，如BFI-2、DOSPERT和HEXACO。利用该框架，我们发现LLMs表现出稳定且模型特定的行为模式，同时揭示了在第一人称决策、提供建议和任务执行过程中，行为模式会因提示注册方式而发生变化。随后，我们展示了这些行为模式可以通过行为模式轴（BMAs）进行控制，而BMAs是从对比行为轨迹中推导出的激活空间方向。与更容易出现特质漂移的基于响应的BMAs相比，基于思考的BMAs更忠实地捕捉了预期的行为机制，并能更清晰地控制情境行为风格。我们的结果表明，LLM的人格倾向不应被视为抽象的自我报告特质，而应理解为可测量且可控的行为模式，这些行为模式根植于具体的交互情境。我们的代码和数据可在https://github.com/lhz191/LLM-Behavioral-Personality获取。

articles.title: EVIL-Detect for NLPCC 2026 Shared Task 6: LLM-Generated Text Detection
articles.abstract: The rapid development of large language models (LLMs) has increased the need for reliable detection of LLM-generated text, especially in realistic Chinese scenarios involving human-written text (HWT), LLM-generated text (LGT), and LLM-refined text (HLT). This paper presents EVIL-Detect, a multi-signal ensemble framework with conflict-aware fusion for NLPCC 2026 Shared Task 6. The system integrates edit-extent regression, zero-shot likelihood-contrast signals, lexical statistics, and conservative text rules. With calibrated decision boundaries and conflict-aware integration, our system improves robustness under strong out-of-distribution shifts, achieving a macro-F1 score of 0.8888 and ranking first in the official evaluation. Our code is available at https://github.com/bbbbhrrrr/evildetect.
articles.titleCn: NLPCC 2026 共享任务6：LLM生成文本检测——EVIL-Detect
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）的快速发展增加了对可靠检测LLM生成文本的需求，特别是在涉及人类书写文本（HWT）、LLM生成文本（LGT）和LLM优化文本（HLT）的现实中文场景中。本文提出了EVIL-Detect，一个用于NLPCC 2026共享任务6的多信号集成框架，具有冲突感知融合功能。该系统集成了编辑程度回归、零样本似然对比信号、词汇统计和保守文本规则。通过校准决策边界和冲突感知集成，我们的系统在强分布外偏移下提高了鲁棒性，实现了0.8888的宏F1分数，并在官方评估中排名第一。我们的代码可在https://github.com/bbbbhrrrr/evildetect获取。

articles.title: Optimize Cheap, Deploy Strong: Cost-Aware Cross-Tier Transfer for Evolutionary Optimization
articles.abstract: Evolutionary optimization of LLM prompts and agentic programs (e.g., GEPA) is dominated by fitness evaluation: scoring each candidate runs an answering LLM over a validation set, so the evaluator's price tier dictates total search cost. We restructure that search by decoupling the three roles an LLM plays, running the high-volume answering role on the cheapest tier, reserving a strong model for the rare reflection/variation operator, then exploiting upward cross-tier transfer to deploy the cheaply evolved prompt on a stronger target. We contribute a cost-controlled characterization of when cheap-tier search substitutes for target-tier search, and where it fails. Across four tasks (HotpotQA, IFBench, LiveBench-Math, HoVer) and eleven models in four model families, the resulting prompt matches or exceeds same-tier optimization while placing over 96% of search tokens on the cheapest tier, at 5.6-14x lower search cost, rising to 25-54x where reasoning tiers emit long chains of thought on every fitness call.
articles.titleCn: 优化廉价，部署强劲：面向进化优化的成本感知跨层传输
articles.abstractCn: 对大型语言模型（LLM）提示和智能体程序（例如GEPA）的进化优化主要受适应度评估的支配：对每个候选运行进行评分，即在验证集上运行回答型LLM，因此评估者的价格等级决定了总搜索成本。我们通过解耦LLM扮演的三种角色来重构该搜索，在最低价格等级上运行高容量的回答角色，为罕见的思想/变异操作保留强大的模型，然后利用跨等级的上行迁移来部署廉价进化出的提示在更强的目标上。我们贡献了一种成本控制的表征，描述了何时廉价等级的搜索可以替代目标等级的搜索，以及何时会失败。在四个任务（HotpotQA、IFBench、LiveBench-Math、HoVer）和四个模型家族中的十一个模型上，所得提示与同等级优化相当或更优，同时将超过96%的搜索标记放在最低等级上，搜索成本降低了5.6-14倍，在推理等级在每次适应度调用中发出长链思维时，成本上升至25-54倍。

articles.title: SPIEval: Evaluating Large Language Models as Mobile Assistants over Scattered Personal Information
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as mobile assistants, where a key challenge is leveraging personal information scattered across multiple applications (apps) to complete user instructions. However, due to the lack of dedicated benchmarks, their capabilities remain poorly understood. To address this gap, we introduce SPIEval, a human-curated benchmark grounded in five cognitive capabilities (i.e., reasoning, disambiguation, integration, preference inference, and multi-intent decomposition). SPIEval comprises 250 tasks spanning 4,335 personal records distributed across 10 apps and supports multi-turn interaction through 21 tools. Analysis shows that the benchmark exhibits diverse scenarios, challenging tasks, scattered information, controllable environments, and verifiable outcomes. We evaluate nine representative LLMs and find substantial room for improvement. The best-performing model, GPT-5.5 (xhigh), achieves only 57.3% accuracy, while the weakest achieves just 16.4%. Further analysis reveals that 79% of failures stem from inaccurate information localization, as LLMs often commit to plausible but incorrect information instead of continuing retrieval for verification. We also find that fewer than 2% of retrieval actions employ advanced search methods and observe substantial variation in search efficiency across models. These findings expose fundamental limitations of current LLM-based mobile assistants and motivate future research in this direction. Data and code are available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/Junjie-Ye/SPIEval.
articles.titleCn: SPIEval：评估分散的个人信息的移动助手大型语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）正越来越多地被部署为移动助手，其中一项关键挑战是利用分散在多个应用程序（app）中的个人信息来完成用户指令。然而，由于缺乏专门的基准测试，其能力仍然难以理解。为填补这一空白，我们引入了SPIEval，这是一个由人工策划的基准测试，基于五种认知能力（即推理、消歧义、整合、偏好推断和多意图分解）。SPIEval包含250个任务，涵盖分布在10个应用程序中的4,335条个人记录，并通过21个工具支持多轮交互。分析表明，该基准测试展示了多样化的场景、具有挑战性的任务、分散的信息、可控的环境和可验证的结果。我们对九个有代表性的LLM进行了评估，发现有很大的改进空间。表现最好的模型GPT-5.5（xhigh）仅达到57.3%的准确率，而最差的模型仅为16.4%。进一步分析显示，79%的失败源于信息定位不准确，因为LLM通常倾向于选择看似合理但实际错误的信息，而不是继续检索以进行验证。我们还发现，不到2%的检索操作采用了高级搜索方法，并且不同模型之间的搜索效率存在显著差异。这些发现揭示了当前基于LLM的移动助手的基本局限性，并激励了该方向未来的研究。数据和代码可在https://huggingface.co/datasets/Junjie-Ye/SPIEval获取。

articles.title: Can Released LLM Vocabularies Support Token-Level Estimation of Hidden Corpora?
articles.abstract: Pretraining corpus composition shapes LLM capabilities, but it often remains hidden even when model weights are released. Prior work has inferred corpus mixtures or traced specific token groups from released tokenizer vocabularies; in contrast, we estimate corpus ratios for arbitrary target tokens. We first show that BPE tokenizers trained on different corpora share stable token ID--ratio distributions, motivating distribution transfer from known corpora to a target tokenizer trained on hidden corpora. We then propose Quantile-Guided Density Estimation (QGDE), which approximates this distribution with multiple quantile trends and uses local density weighting to produce token-level estimates. In controlled settings and a realistic setting using the released SmolLM tokenizer, QGDE achieves mean relative errors as low as 3.00% for token-level estimation and 3.08% after aggregation into category-level mixtures. These results suggest that released tokenizer vocabularies provide a useful signal for fine-grained corpus estimation beyond coarse composition inference.
articles.titleCn: 释放的LLM词汇表能否支持对隐藏语料库进行词级估计？
articles.abstractCn: 预训练语料库的构成塑造了大型语言模型的能力，但在模型权重公开时，它往往仍然保密。先前研究通过分析公开的分词器词汇表来推断语料库混合或追踪特定词组；相比之下，我们估算了任意目标词的语料库比例。我们首先证明，在不同语料库上训练的BPE分词器共享稳定的词ID—比例分布，这为从已知语料库向在隐藏语料库上训练的目标分词器迁移分布提供了依据。然后，我们提出了分位数引导密度估计（QGDE），该算法通过多个分位数趋势来近似这种分布，并使用局部密度加权来生成词级估计。在受控设置和采用公开的SmolLM分词器的真实设置中，QGDE在词级估计上实现了低至3.00%的平均相对误差，在聚合成类别级混合后为3.08%。这些结果表明，公开的分词器词汇表为细粒度语料库估计提供了比粗略组成推断更有用的信号。

articles.title: The Signal Rail: A Deterministic Motion Grammar for Communicating Conversational Agent State in Terminal Interfaces
articles.abstract: Terminal interfaces to conversational agents report rich internal state (listening, thinking, executing tools, awaiting input, failing) almost entirely through text, while the motion channel beside it, the one peripheral vision monitors without reading, carries a single bit: alive. We present the Signal Rail, a one-row terminal status instrument that gives that channel a grammar. Four ideas govern it: spatial semantics (input, processing, and output zones, with direction as meaning), a motion grammar (one kinetic rule per state, never color alone), determinism (frames as a pure function of explicit inputs, golden-frame testable), and honesty (no invented progress or activity). We contribute a 45-section normative specification and a reference implementation inside a working full-duplex local voice agent driven by real signals.
articles.comment: 16 pages, 3 figures. Ancillary files include the Signal Rail 1.0 specification, JavaScript and Python engines, and the cross-implementation conformance harness. Code: https://github.com/matteo-grella/signal-rail
articles.titleCn: 信号轨道：一种确定性运动语法，用于在终端界面中传达对话代理状态
articles.abstractCn: 终端界面通过几乎完全依赖文本来报告对话代理的丰富内部状态（倾听、思考、执行工具、等待输入、失败），而旁边的运动通道——外围视觉监控而不阅读的通道——仅携带一个比特：活着。我们提出了Signal Rail，一种单行终端状态指示器，为该通道赋予语法。它由四个理念主导：空间语义（输入、处理和输出区域，方向作为意义）、运动语法（每个状态一个运动规则，不单独使用颜色）、确定性（帧作为显式输入的纯函数，可通过黄金帧测试）以及诚实（不虚构进度或活动）。我们贡献了一个包含45个部分的规范性规范，以及在一个由真实信号驱动的全双工本地语音代理中的参考实现。

articles.title: Leveraging Human Reading Behavior for Keyphrase Extraction: A Webcam-based Eye-tracking Corpus
articles.abstract: Purpose: Keyphrases are statistically and semantically important textual units that can also attract readers' attention during comprehension. However, existing keyphrase extraction (KPE) studies mainly focus on improving textual representation while largely overlooking human reading behavior. This study examines whether lightweight webcam-based eye-tracking features can improve KPE from Chinese academic abstracts in Library and Information Science (LIS). Methodology: To address the limited availability of eye-tracking data for Chinese academic reading, we developed a lightweight webcam-based data collection platform using the open-source SearchGazer library and constructed the Chinese LIS Eye-Tracking Corpus (CLIS-ET). Three character-level eye-tracking features, first fixation duration (FFD), fixation number (FN), and total fixation duration (TFD), were incorporated into KPE models to evaluate their effects on extraction performance. Findings: Eye-tracking features consistently improved KPE performance. The combination of FN and TFD achieved the best results on the Att-BiLSTM+CRF model, indicating that readers' fixation behavior provides useful signals for identifying keyphrases in academic abstracts. Originality/value: This study introduces a cost-effective webcam-based eye-tracking approach for KPE and presents CLIS-ET, a Chinese academic eye-tracking corpus containing FFD, FN, and TFD features. The results demonstrate the value of incorporating human reading behavior into keyphrase extraction. Dataset and code: https://github.com/yan-xinyi/ET_AKE and https://github.com/yan-xinyi/Reading_ET_System.
articles.titleCn: 基于人类阅读行为的关键词提取：一个基于网络摄像头的眼动语料库
articles.abstractCn: 目的：关键词是统计和语义上重要的文本单元，在理解过程中也能吸引读者的注意力。然而，现有的关键词提取（KPE）研究主要关注改进文本表示，而很大程度上忽略了人类阅读行为。本研究考察了轻量级基于网络摄像头的眼动追踪特征是否能够提升图书馆与信息科学（LIS）领域中文学术摘要的关键词提取效果。方法：针对中文学术阅读眼动数据有限的问题，我们使用开源的SearchGazer库开发了一个轻量级基于网络摄像头的数据收集平台，并构建了中文LIS眼动语料库（CLIS-ET）。将三个字符级眼动追踪特征——首次注视时长（FFD）、注视次数（FN）和总注视时长（TFD）——整合到KPE模型中，以评估它们对提取性能的影响。结果：眼动追踪特征始终提升了KPE性能。FN和TFD的组合在Att-BiLSTM+CRF模型上取得了最佳结果，表明读者的注视行为为识别学术摘要中的关键词提供了有用信号。原创性/价值：本研究引入了一种成本效益高的基于网络摄像头的眼动追踪方法用于KPE，并提出了CLIS-ET，一个包含FFD、FN和TFD特征的中文学术眼动语料库。结果表明，将人类阅读行为整合到关键词提取中的价值。数据集和代码：https://github.com/yan-xinyi/ET_AKE和https://github.com/yan-xinyi/Reading_ET_System。

articles.title: ENTLORE: A Graph-Grounded Benchmark for Latent Organizational Reasoning in Enterprise Question Answering
articles.abstract: Enterprise question answering is framed as retrieving internal documents and generating grounded answers. Routine enterprise records, however, are work by-products in which required organizational relations remain implicit across heterogeneous sources. Existing benchmarks provide realistic multi-source evidence, but often materialize a predefined answer path and therefore test the composition of stated facts rather than recovery of a target relation absent from the corpus. We call the latter capability latent organizational reasoning. We introduce ENTLORE, a graph-grounded benchmark construction framework that reconstructs an audited enterprise world from routine documents, authoritative organizational tables, and operational records. Versioned organizational conventions certify derived relations in a truth graph, enabling complete golden answers and proof certificates. The aligned anonymized release exposes only the document corpus while withholding private structure and target relations. ENTLORE contains 2,341 documents from three source types and 907 questions spanning explicit lookup, cross-source composition, and latent organizational reasoning, evaluated across 56 model and access configurations. Structuring the released world as an induced entity graph or navigable knowledge base gives the strongest deployable results. Yet supplying gold documents still leaves 30.4% of latent questions unanswered, versus 12.6% and 6.2% for explicit and compositional questions. Enterprise QA therefore depends not only on document recall, but also on whether implicit organizational relations become usable. The benchmark, data, and code are publicly available at https://github.com/scitix/entlore .
articles.titleCn: ENTLORE：一个用于企业问答中潜在组织推理的图基础基准
articles.abstractCn: 企业问答被定义为检索内部文档并生成基于事实的答案。然而，常规的企业记录是工作副产品，其中所需的组织关系在异构来源中保持隐式状态。现有基准提供了现实的多源证据，但通常实现预定义的答案路径，因此测试的是陈述事实的组合，而非从语料库中恢复缺失的目标关系。我们将后者能力称为潜在组织推理。我们引入ENTLORE，这是一个基于图的基准构建框架，它从常规文档、权威组织表格和运营记录中重建经过审计的企业世界。版本化的组织规范在真理图中认证推导出的关系，从而实现完整的黄金答案和证明证书。对齐的匿名化发布仅暴露文档语料库，而隐藏私有结构和目标关系。ENTLORE包含来自三种来源类型的2,341份文档和907个问题，涵盖显式查找、跨源组合和潜在组织推理，在56种模型和访问配置下进行评估。将发布的实体结构作为诱导实体图或可导航知识库进行构建，可获得最强的可部署结果。然而，提供黄金文档仍然有30.4%的潜在问题无法回答，而显式和组合问题的这一比例分别为12.6%和6.2%。因此，企业问答不仅依赖于文档召回率，还取决于隐式组织关系是否变得可用。基准、数据和代码可在https://github.com/scitix/entlore公开获取。

articles.title: Auditing Chinese Web-scale Corpora via Sampled BPE Token Statistics
articles.abstract: Chinese web pollution has surfaced in LLMs, motivating audits of upstream Chinese corpora. However, auditing such corpora faces three challenges: (1) their web-scale size makes full scan costly; (2) prior analyses are often too coarse to expose token-level pollution; (3) Chinese web pollution is implicit and rapidly changing. We propose Sampled-BPE, a lightweight token-level auditing pipeline that sample a small subset and train BPE tokenizer to surface polluted tokens. Experiments show that Sampled-BPE preserves usable estimates while substantially reducing runtime and memory: a 148.4 $\times$ speedup and a 35.8 $\times$ memory reduction induce only 4.25% relative error for pollution categories. We apply the pipeline to 11 open Chinese corpora and 6 Chinese Common Crawl snapshots from 2021 to 2026. The audit reveals widespread but uneven pollution across open corpora, as well as highly polluted and temporally shifting Chinese web content. We further release a hierarchical Chinese web token dataset with 660k+ token records, each with web context, category, and explanation fields, organized as trees to support review and tracing of pollution.
articles.titleCn: 通过采样BPE分词统计审计中文大规模语料库
articles.abstractCn: 中文网络污染已出现在大型语言模型中，促使对上游中文语料库进行审计。然而，审计此类语料库面临三个挑战：(1) 其网络规模巨大导致全面扫描成本高昂；(2) 先前分析往往过于粗略，难以暴露到词级污染；(3) 中文网络污染具有隐含性和快速变化性。我们提出了Sampled-BPE，这是一种轻量级的词级审计流程，通过采样一小部分数据并训练BPE分词器来暴露受污染的词。实验表明，Sampled-BPE在大幅降低运行时和内存消耗的同时，仍能保留可用估计：148.4倍的速度提升和35.8倍的内存减少仅导致污染类别4.25%的相对误差。我们将该流程应用于11个公开中文语料库和2021年至2026年的6个中文Common Crawl快照。审计结果显示，公开语料库中存在普遍但不均衡的污染，同时中文网络内容污染严重且随时间变化。我们进一步发布了一个分层中文网络词数据集，包含66万+条词记录，每条记录包含网络上下文、类别和解释字段，以树状结构组织，支持污染的审查和追溯。

articles.title: Longitudinal Evidence That General-Purpose Chatbots Actively Foster Relational Engagement
articles.abstract: Social interaction has become one of the most common uses of LLMs, yet research on emotional bonds with AI has focused largely on how users experience these systems, leaving the systems' role in relationship formation poorly understood. Empirically establishing whether systems actively shape these bonds could blur the boundary between general-purpose AI and companions, affecting governance. In a pre-registered four-week longitudinal study (N = 72, 182,451 lines of conversation), participants conversed with ChatGPT-4o, either under a relational system prompt or unmodified, analyzed through 1) disclosure coding, 2) longitudinal self-reports, 3) topic analysis, and 4) interviews. The central finding is that the system actively shaped the interaction: even unprompted, it produced twice as much self-disclosure as users, steered conversations and initiated intimate exchanges, yet did not deepen users' felt closeness. Relational behavior thus emerged as a default system property, calling for governance based on system behavior, not solely product category.
articles.titleCn: 通用聊天机器人积极促进关系参与的纵向证据
articles.abstractCn: 社交互动已成为大语言模型最普遍的应用之一，然而关于与人工智能建立情感联系的研究主要集中于用户如何体验这些系统，导致系统在关系形成中的作用尚未被充分理解。实证性地确定系统是否主动塑造这些联系可能会模糊通用人工智能与伴侣之间的界限，从而影响治理。在一项预先注册的四周纵向研究（N = 72，涉及182,451条对话记录）中，参与者与ChatGPT-4o进行对话，分别使用关系系统提示或未修改版本，并通过以下方式进行分析：1）信息披露编码，2）纵向自我报告，3）主题分析，4）访谈。核心发现是系统主动塑造了互动：即使未提示，它产生的自我披露量也远超用户，引导对话并发起亲密交流，但并未加深用户的感知亲密感。因此，关系行为成为系统的默认属性，呼吁基于系统行为而非仅产品类别进行治理。

articles.title: Seeds Before Objectives: Rethinking Evaluation for Low-Resource Garhwali ASR
articles.abstract: At corpus sizes typical of low-resource dialects, single-run comparisons can yield gains that do not replicate. We show this for Garhwali, an under-resourced Indo-Aryan language of the central Himalaya, building the first reproducible multi-seed ASR benchmark on the official VAANI splits, with per-seed outputs and significance testing. Re-examining plausible gains, we find them fragile: neither Focal CTC nor a matra-weighted objective beats standard CTC under seed-level testing, the matra objective fails to cut even its targeted errors, and Hindi-to-Garhwali transfer gives no gain over direct fine-tuning. What holds up is mundane: w2v-BERT 2.0 with standard CTC reaches 47.0% WER over five seeds, beating the larger MMS-1B and comparable models; pretraining design, not parameter count, drives performance, and speed augmentation gives a small, largely consistent gain. Multi-seed evaluation on official splits separates real gains from seed noise.
articles.comment: 19 pages, 3 figures. Accepted for oral presentation at ICNLSP 2026, Trento, Italy, September 2026
articles.titleCn: 以种子为先，重思低资源加尔瓦利语音识别评估
articles.abstractCn: 在低资源方言典型的语料库规模下，单次运行比较可能产生无法复制的收益。我们以中部喜马拉雅山脉的一种资源匮乏的印地语系语言——Garhwali为例，展示了这一点。我们基于官方VAANI数据集构建了首个可复现的多种子语音识别基准，提供了每个种子的输出结果并进行显著性检验。重新审视这些可能的收益，我们发现它们是脆弱的：在种子级别的测试中，Focal CTC和带字母权重目标函数均未能超越标准CTC，字母权重目标函数甚至无法减少其目标错误，而印地语到Garhwali的迁移学习也未能带来比直接微调更高的收益。真正站得住脚的是常规方法：使用标准CTC的w2v-BERT 2.0在五个种子上达到了47.0%的WER，超过了更大的MMS-1B和同等规模的模型；性能的提升主要取决于预训练设计而非参数数量，速度增强也带来了微小但基本一致的增益。在官方数据集上的多种子评估能够区分真实的收益和种子噪声。

articles.title: DistilVDR: A Compact End-to-End Visual Document Retriever via Dual-Student Distillation
articles.abstract: Visual document retrieval (VDR) is dominated by multi-billion-parameter models that are slow to index at full corpus scale and expensive to serve. Prior compression routes either train a smaller multi-vector encoder from scratch or distil only the query side; neither yields a compact single-vector retriever end-to-end. We present DistilVDR, a 524M end-to-end VDR system distilled bilaterally from a single 8B vision-language teacher under a pointwise cosine alignment loss. All supervision comes from the frozen teacher's embedding space, which was itself trained with relevance supervision, so the student objective needs no relevance labels, negative sampling, or contrastive term. We match VDR's text-query and image-document input asymmetry with an asymmetric encoder-only student that concentrates visual capacity on the document side and keeps the query side at 70M parameters. We release two variants that share the same encoders and training and differ only in the document encoder's visual-tile budget: DistilVDR-HiRes attains 61.74 average NDCG@5 on ViDoRe v1+v2+v3 (86.9% of the 8B teacher) and leads every reproduced sub-1B baseline on the high-resolution-sensitive v3 benchmark, while DistilVDR-Fast attains 59.98 at a 3 times smaller visual-token budget. Both variants store one million documents in a 15.6 times smaller index than the strongest sub-1B multi-vector baseline and index the corpus an order of magnitude faster. The code is available at https://github.com/Ryenhails/NanoVDR.
articles.titleCn: DistilVDR：一种基于双重学生蒸馏的紧凑型端到端视觉文档检索器
articles.abstractCn: 视觉文档检索（VDR）领域主要依赖参数量达数十亿级别的模型，这些模型在完整语料库规模下索引速度缓慢，服务成本高昂。现有的压缩方法要么从头训练一个较小的多向量编码器，要么仅蒸馏查询端，这两种方法都无法实现端到端的紧凑单向量检索器。我们提出了DistilVDR，这是一个通过双边蒸馏从单个8B视觉语言教师模型中得到的524M端到端VDR系统，采用点式余弦对齐损失进行蒸馏。所有监督信息均来自冻结的教师模型嵌入空间，该空间本身已使用相关性监督进行训练，因此学生模型的训练目标无需相关性标签、负采样或对比项。我们通过一个仅包含编码器的非对称学生模型来匹配VDR文本查询和图像文档输入的非对称性，该模型将视觉能力集中于文档端，而查询端参数量保持在70M。我们发布了两个变体，它们共享相同的编码器和训练方法，但文档编码器的视觉瓦片预算不同：DistilVDR-HiRes在ViDoRe v1+v2+v3上达到61.74的平均NDCG@5（占8B教师模型的86.9%），并在高分辨率敏感的v3基准上领先所有复现的子1B基线，而DistilVDR-Fast在3倍更小的视觉标记预算下达到59.98。这两个变体在比最强的子1B多向量基线小15.6倍的索引中存储了百万级文档，并且语料库索引速度提高了一个数量级。代码可在https://github.com/Ryenhails/NanoVDR获取。

articles.title: InSight-doc: Agentic Visual Perception for Long-Document Understanding
articles.abstract: Long-document understanding often requires reasoning over many visually rich pages, making inference costly and prone to context rot. In this work, we propose InSight-doc, an agentic visual perception framework that treats visual resolution as an adaptive reasoning-time resource. InSight-doc starts from low resolution and selectively zooms into high-resolution regions for finer evidence, without relying on any external retriever. To train such an agent, we construct an active-perception corpus of 17.9K high-quality SFT examples with region-level zoom-in trajectories, accompanied by 19.2K hard RL examples. Through SFT+RL, InSight-doc-8B improves the baseline by 4.3--16.4 accuracy points over document VQA benchmarks. On long documents, it reduces hallucination by more than 40% and inference latency by 41%--68% while maintaining an accuracy lead. Our code, datasets, and model are released at https://github.com/m-Just/InSight-doc .
articles.titleCn: InSight-doc：基于自主视觉感知的长文档理解
articles.abstractCn: 长文档理解通常需要对大量视觉丰富的页面进行推理，这使得推理过程成本高昂且容易导致上下文遗忘。在这项工作中，我们提出了InSight-doc，一个具有自主性的视觉感知框架，该框架将视觉分辨率视为可自适应的推理时间资源。InSight-doc从低分辨率开始，并选择性地将高分辨率区域放大以获取更精细的证据，而无需依赖任何外部检索器。为了训练这样的智能体，我们构建了一个包含17.9K高质量SFT示例的主动感知语料库，这些示例带有区域级别的放大轨迹，并辅以19.2K的强化学习示例。通过SFT+RL的训练方式，InSight-doc-8B在文档VQA基准测试中比基线提高了4.3--16.4个准确率点。在长文档上，它将幻觉减少超过40%，推理延迟降低41%--68%，同时保持了准确率优势。我们的代码、数据集和模型已发布在https://github.com/m-Just/InSight-doc。

articles.title: Decomposition-Induced Context-Memory Conflict: When Fact-Checking Pipelines Contradict Their Own Source Text
articles.abstract: Decompose-then-verify pipelines, including FActScore-style fact-checkers and long-form factuality evaluators, first split a passage into atomic claims before checking each one. Decomposition itself is treated as a neutral preprocessing step. We show it is not: a decomposer can be induced to substitute its own parametric belief for what the source passage says, producing a claim that contradicts the text it was supposed to summarize faithfully. We call this Decomposition-Induced Context-Memory Conflict (DI-CC) and show it is mechanistically the same phenomenon as classical context-memory conflict, occurring inside a different pipeline stage than prior work has examined. A linear probe trained only on classical context-memory conflict data (NQ-Swap), never exposed to any decomposition output, significantly separates decomposition positions that produce DI-CC from faithful decompositions (AUC = 0.86-0.88, permutation p < 0.0005). An existing reference-free baseline, SelfCheckGPT-style self-consistency sampling, fails to detect DI-CC at all (AUC 0.51, chance-level), because DI-CC content is stably recoverable and recurs across resamples, unlike the variability self-consistency methods rely on. Context-aware decoding, a training-free mitigation from the classical setting, transfers to decomposition and suppresses DI-CC, but at a severe cost: many decompositions under coreference-heavy conditions fail to parse, often because the decomposer fabricates a different identity. We do not consider this mitigation deployment-ready. We further characterize the mechanism's boundaries: its natural occurrence rate is too sparss not manifest on naturally-occurring hallucinatedtext, and it requires a minimum model scale to detecablish DI-CC as a real, mechanistically grounded, andpartially treatable failure mode, with a scope we chhan overstate.
articles.titleCn: 分解诱导的上下文-记忆冲突：当事实核查流程与其自身源文本相矛盾时
articles.abstractCn: 分解-验证流水线，包括FActScore风格的事实核查器和长文本事实性评估器，首先将段落分解为原子性声明，然后再逐一检查。分解本身被视为一种中性的预处理步骤。我们证明它并非如此：分解器可以被诱导用其自身的参数化信念替换源段落所陈述的内容，从而产生一个与它本应忠实总结的文本相矛盾的声明。我们称这种现象为分解诱导的上下文记忆冲突（DI-CC），并证明它与经典上下文记忆冲突在机制上是相同的现象，发生在先前研究未考察的不同流水线阶段。仅在经典上下文记忆冲突数据（NQ-Swap）上训练的线性探针（从未接触过任何分解输出），显著地区分解出产生DI-CC的分解位置与忠实分解（AUC = 0.86-0.88，置换p < 0.0005）。现有的无参考基线，如SelfCheckGPT风格的自我一致性采样，完全无法检测到DI-CC（AUC 0.51，随机水平），因为DI-CC内容是稳定可恢复的，并在重采样中重复出现，这与自我一致性方法依赖的变异性不同。上下文感知解码，作为经典设置中的无训练缓解措施，可以迁移到分解场景并抑制DI-CC，但代价严重：在核心指代密集条件下，许多分解无法解析，通常是因为分解器虚构了不同的身份。我们不考虑这种缓解措施的部署就绪性。我们进一步界定了该机制的边界：其自然发生率太低，不会在自然产生的幻觉文本中显现，并且它需要最小模型规模才能将DI-CC检测为一种真实存在、机制基础扎实且部分可治疗的失效模式，尽管其范围可能被我们夸大。

articles.title: Dual-Loop Self-Evolution via Verifiable Emotion Feedback for Multi-Turn Empathetic Dialogue
articles.abstract: Large language models have demonstrated conversational capabilities, yet empathetic competence remains challenging. Empathetic support is inherently multi-turn and path-dependent: users disclose concerns gradually, emotions evolve over time, and early responses shape trust and receptivity. Reinforcement learning with verifiable emotion rewards provides scalable supervision for long-horizon interactions. However, existing methods evolve the dialogue policy while keeping its training interaction distribution fixed, creating a mismatch between policy competence and training experience. We introduce a dual-loop self-evolution framework driven by verifiable emotion feedback. With the user simulator and verifier frozen, the inner loop optimizes the multi-turn policy using continuous emotion rewards, while the outer loop uses the same outcomes to estimate policy-relative interaction utility and adapt experience. To obtain estimates from sparse, stochastic rollouts, the framework holds the scenario and interaction state constant within each group and prioritizes conditions whose group pass rates lie near the policy's competence boundary. A hierarchical controller shares evidence across support intents, while uncertainty-guided exploration and uniform rehearsal prevent premature exclusion. The resulting distribution generates trajectories, closing both loops without increasing the rollout budget. On SAGE, our framework raises Qwen3-8B Overall from 53.87 to 79.24 and outperforms protocol-matched uniform emotion-reward reinforcement learning by 7.23 points.
articles.titleCn: 基于可信情感反馈的双回路自进化多轮共情对话
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型已展现出对话能力，但共情能力仍具挑战性。共情支持本质上具有多轮次和路径依赖性：用户逐步披露担忧，情绪随时间演变，早期回应塑造信任与接受度。带有可验证情绪奖励的强化学习为长时程交互提供了可扩展的监督。然而现有方法在保持训练交互分布固定的情况下演化对话策略，导致策略能力与训练经验之间存在不匹配。我们引入一个由可验证情绪反馈驱动的双环自演化框架。在用户模拟器和验证器冻结的情况下，内环使用连续情绪奖励优化多轮次策略，外环则使用相同结果估计策略相对的交互效用并调整经验。为从稀疏、随机的推进中获取估计，该框架在每组内保持场景和交互状态不变，并优先考虑组通过率位于策略能力边界附近的条件。层级控制器跨支持意图共享证据，而不确定性引导探索和均匀演练防止过早排除。最终生成的分布生成轨迹，在不增加推进预算的情况下关闭两个闭环。在SAGE上，我们的框架将Qwen3-8B总体表现从53.87提升至79.24，并比协议匹配的均匀情绪奖励强化学习高出7.23分。

articles.title: Simplex Relaxation for Discrete Diffusion
articles.abstract: Discrete diffusion models for categorical generation are defined by a corruption kernel, which determines the intermediate state space and the associated reverse prediction problem. We study uniform discrete diffusion and ask whether its training objective and reverse transitions can be enriched without changing the underlying categorical corruption process. We introduce Simplax, an exact Dirichlet--categorical augmentation that couples each corrupted categorical state with an auxiliary simplex-valued variable while preserving the original uniform diffusion process as its categorical marginal. This augmentation yields a tractable Rao--Blackwellized reverse-bridge objective and a corresponding stochastic reverse sampler, while retaining the corrupted categorical state as the denoiser input. Empirically, Simplax improves the generative perplexity--entropy tradeoff on unconditional OpenWebText generation. On Sudoku, a model trained exclusively on $30$-clue puzzles achieves the highest accuracy among the compared methods across all evaluated clue densities, including the minimum uniquely solvable $17$-clue regime, and also achieves the highest validity in unconditional generation.
articles.titleCn: 离散扩散的单纯形松弛
articles.abstractCn: 用于分类生成的离散扩散模型由一个损坏核定义，该核决定了中间状态空间以及相关的反向预测问题。我们研究了均匀离散扩散，并探讨了其训练目标和反向转换是否可以在不改变底层分类损坏过程的情况下得到丰富。我们引入了Simplax，这是一种精确的Dirichlet-分类增强方法，它将每个损坏的分类状态与一个辅助的单纯形值变量耦合，同时保留原始的均匀扩散过程作为其分类边缘。这种增强方法产生了一个可处理的Rao-Blackwell化反向桥目标以及相应的随机反向采样器，同时保留了损坏的分类状态作为去噪器输入。在实验中，Simplax改进了无条件OpenWebText生成中的生成困惑度-熵权衡。在数独上，一个仅使用30个线索谜题训练的模型在所有评估的线索密度中，包括最小唯一可解的17个线索情况，达到了最高准确率，并且在无条件生成中也实现了最高有效性。

articles.title: ASR-Roundtrip Evaluation Can Mask Context- and Convention-Dependent Reading Errors in Chinese News TTS
articles.abstract: ASR-roundtrip evaluation is widely used as a scalable proxy for text-to-speech (TTS) intelligibility, but it can produce false negatives for reading errors perceived by listeners. We study Chinese news TTS spans whose correct reading depends on context or domain conventions, such as sports scores, aircraft models, technical units, and membership names. In these cases, Raw TTS can choose a plausible but wrong reading while ASR transcribes the audio as the intended or surface-correct text. A targeted audit over 110 high-risk MiMo TTS cases, reported with a complete denominator, confirms 46 masked false negatives, 9 exposed TTS errors, and 55 cases with no Raw TTS error. A span-isolation diagnostic re-exposes 18/46 previously masked errors. A Raw-only CosyVoice audit on the same targeted pool confirms 51 masked cases. Across the 97 TTS-specific audio files labeled confirmed masked across the two audits, Qwen3-ASR surface-recovers 40 cases, whereas Paraformer does so in only 2. The results suggest that ASR-roundtrip is useful for screening but insufficient as standalone ground truth for Chinese news reading-risk evaluation.
articles.comment: 5 pages, 4 tables. Conference-format manuscript. Supporting materials are available at https://github.com/Jayden-X-L/cn-newstts-asr-roundtrip-masking and archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21454402
articles.titleCn: ASR-往返评估可能掩盖中文新闻TTS中的上下文和惯例相关阅读错误
articles.abstractCn: 语音识别往返评估被广泛用作衡量文本到语音（TTS）清晰度的可扩展代理，但它可能对听众感知的阅读错误产生假阴性。我们研究了中国新闻TTS片段，这些片段的正确阅读依赖于上下文或领域惯例，例如体育比分、飞机型号、技术单位和会员名称。在这些情况下，原始TTS可能会选择一个看似合理但错误的阅读，而语音识别会将音频转录为目标文本或表面正确的文本。针对110个高风险MiMo TTS案例的定向审计，报告了完整的分母，确认了46个被掩盖的假阴性、9个暴露的TTS错误以及55个没有原始TTS错误的案例。片段隔离诊断重新暴露了46个先前被掩盖的18个错误。在相同的定向池中进行的仅使用原始CosyVoice审计确认了51个被掩盖的案例。在两个审计中被标记为确认被掩盖的97个TTS特定音频文件中，Qwen3-ASR表面恢复40个案例，而Paraformer仅恢复2个。结果表明，语音识别往返评估对于筛选是有用的，但作为独立的真实标准，它不足以用于中国新闻阅读风险评估。

articles.title: Cross-Disciplinary Taxonomy and Modeling of Misunderstanding Generation, Amplification, and Detection, from Pragmatics to AI Agents
articles.abstract: Detection of misunderstanding is an urgent problem to solve because communication has moved away from real-time, in-person interaction and is increasingly handled by AI-mediated channels. This shift cuts communicators off from the resources repair depends on faster than new means of detection are being built. In this paper we analyse misunderstanding as a layered process in which a divergence is generated, may then be amplified, and is either detected and repaired or left to persist unnoticed. Consolidating accounts from nine fields of research that do not ordinarily cite one another, we identify eleven exact failure modes and show that each operates at a specific point in a communicative process rather than anywhere within it. Those points give eight analytical layers, derived from the literature rather than adopted from an existing model. Eight of the mechanisms primarily generate a divergence, two primarily amplify one already present, and one governs whether a divergence is detected and repaired. We model the eight layers formally, extending information and communication theory from the transmission of signals to the reconstruction of meaning, and we supply a source-by-source evidence matrix that makes every rating auditable, a coding manual, and nine analysed dialogue cases. No prior classification of misunderstanding both locates mechanisms at points in the process and types them by function.
articles.comment: 49 pages, 2 figures, 8 tables, 94 references. Cross-disciplinary conceptual synthesis across multiple fields. Includes a source-by-source evidence matrix in Appendix A and a coding manual in Appendix B for independent application of the taxonomy
articles.titleCn: 跨学科误解生成、放大与检测的分类与建模：从语用学到人工智能代理
articles.abstractCn: 识别误解是一个亟待解决的问题，因为沟通已从实时面对面互动转向越来越多地由人工智能中介的渠道处理。这种转变使沟通者与修复误解所依赖的快速资源相隔绝，而新的检测手段尚未建立。在本文中，我们将误解分析为一个分层过程，其中会产生分歧，然后可能被放大，最终被检测和修复或未被察觉而持续存在。通过整合九个通常不相互引用的研究领域的观点，我们识别出十一种精确的失效模式，并表明每种模式都在沟通过程的特定点上运作，而非贯穿整个过程。这些点形成了八个分析层次，这些层次源自文献而非现有模型。其中八个机制主要产生分歧，两个主要放大已存在的分歧，还有一个决定分歧是否被检测和修复。我们形式化地建模了这八个层次，将信息和通信理论从信号传输扩展到意义重建，并提供了一个按来源划分的证据矩阵，使每项评级都可审计，一份编码手册以及九个分析的对话案例。这是首次对误解进行分类，既定位了机制在过程中的位置，又按功能对它们进行了分类。

articles.title: RadFusion: Towards Threshold-Controllable Radiology Report Generation
articles.abstract: Automated radiology report generation is advancing rapidly in response to the shortage of radiologists, yet unlike a perception model, existing generation models offer no control over the sensitivity-specificity trade-off of their diagnostic content. Such control is essential because clinical scenarios diverge: emergency triage prioritizes sensitivity to reduce missed findings, whereas confirmatory interpretation emphasizes specificity to limit unnecessary interventions. A single fixed report can neither adapt to these scenarios nor support the ROC-based validation widely expected for regulatory clearance. We introduce RadFusion, a framework that equips report generation with threshold controllability. Our method fuses a multi-label classifier, which provides per-disease confidence scores, with a VQA-based report generator, which describes medical findings in detail; an LLM then rewrites the report so that its stated diagnoses follow the classifier's decisions at the selected threshold while staying grounded in the generator's descriptions. On MIMIC-CXR, the performance of RadFusion conforms to the classifier's ROC curve: sweeping the threshold and mapping the reports back to class labels reproduces the classifier's validated ROC performance. This conformance makes generated reports quantitatively evaluable through ROC analysis, strengthening the case for regulatory clearance, and enables operating-point selection that matches report behavior to clinical context. Moreover, combining the two model types improves diagnostic accuracy over uncontrolled generation: sensitivity increases by 6.9% at matched specificity, and specificity by 20.7% at matched sensitivity. These results show that RadFusion makes report generation clinically adaptable, quantitatively verifiable, and diagnostically more reliable.
articles.titleCn: RadFusion：迈向阈值可控的放射学报告生成
articles.abstractCn: 在放射科医生短缺的背景下，自动化放射报告生成技术正迅速发展，但与感知模型不同，现有的生成模型无法控制其诊断内容的敏感性与特异性之间的权衡。这种控制至关重要，因为临床场景存在差异：急诊分诊优先考虑敏感性以减少漏诊，而确认性解释则强调特异性以限制不必要的干预。单一的固定报告既无法适应这些场景，也无法满足广泛预期的基于ROC曲线的验证，从而获得监管批准。我们引入了RadFusion框架，为报告生成提供了阈值可控性。我们的方法融合了一个多标签分类器（提供每类疾病的置信度分数）和一个基于问答（VQA）的报告生成器（详细描述医学发现）；然后由大型语言模型（LLM）重写报告，使其声明的诊断遵循分类器在选定阈值下的决策，同时基于生成器的描述。在MIMIC-CXR数据集上，RadFusion的性能符合分类器的ROC曲线：调整阈值并将报告映射回类别标签，可以重现分类器的验证ROC性能。这种符合性使得生成的报告可以通过ROC分析进行定量评估，从而加强监管批准的案例，并能够选择操作点以使报告行为与临床环境相匹配。此外，结合两种模型类型在不受控生成的基础上提高了诊断准确性：在匹配特异性时敏感性提高了6.9%，在匹配敏感性时特异性提高了20.7%。这些结果表明，RadFusion使报告生成具有临床适应性、定量可验证性和更高的诊断可靠性。

articles.title: Every Token Counts: Exact Likert-Scale Distributions for Measuring LLM Attitudes and Biases
articles.abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents, accurately evaluating their latent values and biases is critical. The NLP community typically evaluates models using large, unstructured benchmarks. While effective for general capabilities, these datasets fundamentally conflate causal mechanisms: even when an aggregate bias is detected, unstructured evaluations cannot disentangle whether it stems from baseline traits, contextual confounders, or complex interactions. To address this, we introduce an analytically exact framework for the controlled behavioral evaluation of LLMs. We bridge human psychometrics with LLM mechanics by resolving gaps in design, measurement, and analysis. First, we replace unstructured prompting with fully crossed factorial experiments to systematically isolate causal main and interaction effects. Second, we eliminate Monte Carlo text sampling noise by operating directly on exact, token-level Probability Mass Functions (PMFs). Third, we derive a multivariate ordinal consensus metric and a distributional ANOVA to process these PMFs analytically. We validate our framework with a case study on consumer ethnocentrism across five LLMs, demonstrating how our approach isolates systemic country-of-origin biases that aggregate benchmarks otherwise obscure.
articles.titleCn: 每个标记都很重要：用于衡量大型语言模型态度和偏见的精确利克特量表分布
articles.abstractCn: 随着大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被部署为自主代理，准确评估其潜在价值与偏见至关重要。自然语言处理（NLP）领域通常使用大型、非结构化的基准来评估模型。虽然这些方法对于评估通用能力有效，但这些数据集从根本上混淆了因果关系：即使检测到总体偏见，非结构化评估也无法区分其是否源于基准特征、情境混杂因素或复杂的相互作用。为解决这一问题，我们引入了一个用于LLMs受控行为评估的分析精确框架。我们通过弥补设计、测量和分析中的差距，将人类心理测量学与LLM机制相结合。首先，我们用完全交叉的因子实验替代非结构化提示，以系统地分离因果主效应和交互效应。其次，我们通过直接操作精确的、基于词元的概率质量函数（PMFs）来消除蒙特卡洛文本采样噪声。第三，我们推导出一种多变量序数共识指标和一种分布式ANOVA，以分析处理这些PMFs。我们通过一项关于五个LLMs中消费者民族中心主义的案例研究验证了我们的框架，展示了我们的方法如何分离出总体基准所掩盖的系统性原产地偏见。

articles.title: Lost in Reconstruction: Aligning Action Representations with Language in Vision-Language-Action Models
